t: This is Fulham House, at 87 Fulham High Street in Fulham. It's a Grade II listed building. Sir Ralph Warren is recorded as having lived here. He was twice Lord Mayor of London, first in 1536 and again in 1543, and he lived from 1483 to 1553. His time here connects this stretch of Fulham High Street with the very top of the City's civic life in the sixteenth century.
